phrases: inform someone that
通知/告知某人某事
I informed him that the meeting had been postponed.
我通知他会议已经推迟了。
contribute towards
为...贡献/捐助
All those who have contributed towards the gift will sign their names.
所有为这份礼物捐款的人都将签名。
mark the occasion
纪念这个时刻/场合
We sent him a present to mark the occasion.
我们送他一份礼物以纪念这个时刻。
remember someone for
因...而记住某人
We shall all remember Mr. Page for his patience.
我们将永远因他的耐心而记住佩奇先生。
in one's honour
为了向某人表示敬意
A great many former pupils will be attending a farewell dinner in his honour.
许多老校友将出席为他举行的告别晚宴。
devote oneself to
致力于；献身于
After he has retired he will devote himself to gardening.
退休后他将致力于园艺。
one is never too old to learn
活到老学到老
One is never too old to learn.
活到老学到老。
go to school
去上学
He gave us encouragement when we went so unwillingly to school.
当我们不情愿地去上学时，他给了我们鼓励。
send someone something
给某人发送/寄送某物
Pupils will be sending him a present.
学生们将送他一份礼物。
It is a curious coincidence that
真是巧合.../说来也巧...
It is a curious coincidence that the day before his retirement, Mr. Page will have been teaching for forty years.
说来也巧，就在他退休前一天，佩奇先生将教满四十年书。

grammar.k: 现在完成进行时 (Present Perfect Continuous Tense)
grammar.f: 主语 + have/has + been + 动词-ing
grammar.d: 表示从过去开始一直持续到现在，并且可能继续下去的动作。常与表示一段时间的时间状语连用，如for+时间段、since+时间点。 用于询问或描述一个持续进行且可能仍在继续的动作，强调动作的持续性。疑问句将have/has提前。
ex: How long has Mr. Page been teaching?
佩奇先生教了多久的书了？
I have been waiting for you for two hours.
我已经等了你两个小时了。
She has been working here since 2010.
她从2010年起就在这里工作了。

grammar.k: 将来完成进行时 (Future Perfect Continuous Tense)
grammar.f: 主语 + will + have + been + 动词-ing
grammar.d: 表示在将来某一时刻之前已经开始并一直持续到该时刻的动作。构成形式为：will + have + been + 动词-ing。 用于描述到将来某个时间点已经持续了多长时间的动作，常与by + 将来的时间点连用。
ex: Mr. Page will have been teaching for forty years by then.
到那时佩奇先生将已经教了四十年书。
By next month, I will have been living here for five years.
到下个月，我将已经在这里住了五年。

grammar.k: 现在完成时与现在完成进行时的区别
grammar.f: 现在完成时：have/has + 过去分词；现在完成进行时：have/has + been + 现在分词
grammar.d: 现在完成时强调动作已完成或结果；现在完成进行时强调动作的持续性，有时带有感情色彩。 表示延续性动词两者均可使用，但现在完成进行时更强调动作的持续过程。短暂动词只能用现在完成时。
ex: I have read the book. (已完成) / I have been reading the book. (一直在读)
我已经读完了这本书。/ 我一直在读这本书。
I have lived here for ten years. / I have been living here for ten years.

patterns.p: How long has + 主语 + been + 动词-ing?
o: How long has Mr. Page been teaching?
佩奇先生教了多久的书了？
im: How long has she been working here?
How long has he been learning English?

patterns.p: 主语 + will have been + 动词-ing + for + 时间段
o: Mr. Page will have been teaching for a total of forty years.
佩奇先生将教满整整四十年书。
im: By next year, she will have been teaching for twenty years.
到明年，她将教满二十年书。
He will have been living here for five years by December.
到十二月，他将在这里住满五年。

patterns.p: It is a curious coincidence that + 从句
o: It is a curious coincidence that the day before his retirement, Mr. Page will have been teaching for forty years.
说来也巧，就在他退休前一天，佩奇先生将教满四十年书。
im: It is a curious coincidence that we met again after ten years.
说来也巧，我们在十年后又相遇了。
It is a curious coincidence that both of them chose the same university.
真是巧合，他们两人都选择了同一所大学。

patterns.p: 主语 + will devote oneself to + 名词/动词-ing
o: After he has retired he will devote himself to gardening.
退休后他将致力于园艺。
im: She will devote herself to teaching after retirement.
退休后她将致力于教学。
He decided to devote himself to writing.
